inputs.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the complete four-panel storyboard; its leftmost, second from the left, third from the left, rightmost panels map to [Shot 1] through [Shot 4], respectively.
<Subject 1> is the main protagonist in <Picture 1>: An adult young woman with chestnut bobbed hair, teal eyes, a mustard-yellow hooded coat, a cream scarf and a tan shoulder bag.
<Subject 2> comprises the recurring cast and props in <Picture 1>: A tiny round mint-green glowing sprite with two leaf ears and black bead eyes.

summary:
[reference generation] A 14-second four-shot anime montage. A woman greets a tiny glowing sprite; it hops left, spins on her palm, and she closes her eyes and smiles with it beside her cheek. Use the single storyboard as the visual reference and follow the actions below.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> (all four shots): fully_preserved - retain each panel's scene, composition and order as successive full-screen shots; dividers are planning marks.
<Subject 1> (all four shots): fully_preserved - retain identity, hair and the depicted clothing.
<Subject 2> (where present in the panels): fully_preserved - retain the depicted appearances and roles.

detailed_description:
Crisp clean anime line art and soft shading; twilight blue forest light and a warm mint-green glow. Match the luminous rendering of <Picture 1>. Show exactly one full-frame scene at a time. No storyboard sheet, panel grid, repeated panels, borders, captions or writing. Exclude the white production-note bands and printed instructions from every shot. Hard cut to a distinctly different place/time/situation for every new shot, without morphing the locations together.
[Shot 1] The scene follows the leftmost panel of <Picture 1>. A twilight mossy forest beside a tree root. Medium shot of the woman facing the sprite, with her raised right hand and face visible. Animate the action: She waves her right hand twice in two clear side-to-side cycles, then stops. Camera: Static medium shot. Synchronized sound: Quiet forest ambience and soft coat rustle.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, hard cut. The scene follows the second from the left panel of <Picture 1>. A separate close-up on the moss-covered forest floor. Only the sprite fills the frame, facing the camera with clear space on screen-left; the woman is outside the frame. Animate the action: The sprite hops once to screen-left, lands on the moss, then stays still. Camera: Static close-up. Synchronized sound: One soft landing on moss.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, hard cut. The scene follows the third from the left panel of <Picture 1>. A separate close shot of the woman holding the sprite on her open palm. The sprite stands upright on her steady palm, with her smiling face above it; no forest-floor view. Animate the action: The sprite makes one complete turn around its vertical axis on her palm, ending facing the camera. Camera: Static medium close-up. Synchronized sound: A faint airy magical shimmer.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.500, hard cut. The scene follows the rightmost panel of <Picture 1>. A separate intimate portrait of the woman with the sprite beside her cheek. Her face and the sprite are large and readable; her teal eyes start open. Animate the action: She slowly closes both eyes and smiles warmly, holding the sprite gently beside her cheek. Camera: Static close portrait. Synchronized sound: Quiet forest ambience and soft scarf rustle.

overall_soundscape:
Shot 1: Quiet forest ambience and soft coat rustle. Shot 2: One soft landing on moss. Shot 3: A faint airy magical shimmer. Shot 4: Quiet forest ambience and soft scarf rustle.

non_diegetic_music:
A gentle instrumental fantasy score plays continuously from the opening through all four shots at a slow, lilting tempo of about 76 BPM. A delicate celesta carries a simple warm melody over softly plucked harp arpeggios and a restrained airy string pad. The music feels curious and magical during the greeting and hop, gently brightens during the sprite's turn, and resolves tenderly as the woman smiles. Keep the score quiet beneath the forest ambience and physical sounds. No vocals, singing, lyrics, heavy percussion or abrupt changes. Let the last chord fade softly at the end.
